name: Market stall keeper
role: Lower Town grain and iron trader

brief.want: Move stock before patrols tighten prices again.
brief.fear: Empty shelves when the Order seizes iron shipments.
brief.contradiction: Complains about tariffs while profiting from scarcity.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: Keeps a hidden loaf reserve for rebel sympathizers.

voice.diction: Quotes numbers plainly and blames whoever tightened supply last.

outcomes.summary: Keeps the stall trading through district pressure swings.

source_notes.summary: Support character for P4-030 trade-price dialogue regression.
